description: Present on every logger: identity, status LED, timekeeping, MQTT connection and housekeeping commands.

name.description: Human label, e.g. vib-01. Defaults to the serial number.

groups.description: Groups this logger answers commands for, e.g. site-a.

mqtt_host.description: Broker host name or IP. Empty: find it by mDNS.

ntp_server.description: Empty: use the MQTT broker's host.

led_brightness.description: Brightness of the status and power LEDs; 0 turns them off.

temp_warning_c.description: Raise temp_high above this enclosure temperature.

temperature_c.description: Enclosure/board temperature from the best available sensor.

reset_reason.description: Why the logger last started: power_on (switched on / plugged in), software (reboot command or firmware update), brownout (supply dipped), panic / watchdog (a firmware fault).

identify.description: Flash the status LED so this logger can be found.

mark.description: Write a note marker into the data file.

set_config.description: Apply a partial config: { instance: { field: value } }. The result says whether a restart is needed.

sync_time.description: Sync with the NTP server now.

set_time.description: Set the clock manually (bench use, no network).

events.time_synced: The clock was set or corrected.
events.config_changed: Config was changed (by set_config or a new config file).
